text: In response to the Member Motion MM13.3, this report provides a comprehensive overview of the Metrolinx Eglinton Crosstown West Extension (ECWE) Elevated Guideway alignment and its setback from Eglinton Avenue West. Additionally, the report examines potential opportunities to minimize setback requirements and relocate the guideway closer to Eglinton Avenue West.

The Infrastructure and Environment Committee: 1. Received the report (February 12, 2024) from the General Manager, Transportation Services, and the Executive Director, Transit Expansion, for information.
